notes: The largest of the three Russian Hill district nominations (Anne Bloomfield, May 1987; listed 22 January 1988 with the Keeper's amended resource count of 26 contributing buildings, 2 sites and 5 structures, 11 non-contributing buildings and 1 site). A 41-page document whose section 8 is a history of the hilltop as much as an inventory: the Livermore family's twenty years of building, Worcester's and Polk's First Bay Area Tradition houses, and the writers and painters who lived among them. The notable past residents here are the point of the nomination's criterion B, and they are taken per issue #310; the Livermores who still live in the district in 1987 are not.
